    • Package org.ether.society.procedural

      • Class org.ether.society.procedural.SimulationPerformanceConfig

        class SimulationPerformanceConfig extends Object implements Serializable
        serialVersionUID:
        1L

        • Serialized Fields

          • climateTickFrequency
            int climateTickFrequency
          • enableMultiFreqClimateTicks
            boolean enableMultiFreqClimateTicks
            Enable multi-frequency climate ticks (e.g. run climate diffusion every N ticks instead of every tick)
          • enableParallelExecution
            boolean enableParallelExecution
            Enable parallel stream execution (may introduce non-deterministic floating-point summation order)
          • enableSparseCellSkipping
            boolean enableSparseCellSkipping
            Enable sparse cell skipping (skip updates for empty deep ocean/desert cells without events)
          • enableSpatialRangeTruncation
            boolean enableSpatialRangeTruncation
            Enable downwind spatial range truncation in dust storm invalid input: '&' pollution dispersion
          • parallelThreadCount
            int parallelThreadCount
            Number of parallel execution threads (0 = auto-detect all available CPU cores, 1 = single-threaded deterministic)
          • strictDeterminism
            boolean strictDeterminism
            Enforce strict bit-identical determinism (disables all approximations)
